quote: I never imagined my small monthly donation could fund an entire leadership workshop. LCA, Abuja showed me exactly where my money went.

faqs.question: How do I make a donation?
faqs.answer: Transfer the amount to the bank account shown on this page, then open WhatsApp from this page and attach your bank transfer receipt in the chat.

faqs.question: Do you collect card details?
faqs.answer: No. We are currently using bank transfers only. Do not send card numbers, expiry dates, CVV codes, PINs, or banking passwords to anyone.

faqs.question: Do I need to send a transfer reference?
faqs.answer: No. The bank receipt contains the transfer reference. Just attach the receipt in the WhatsApp chat.

faqs.question: How do I get a donation receipt?
faqs.answer: Attach the transfer receipt from your bank app in the WhatsApp chat. After we confirm the credit, we will acknowledge your donation. Contact us if you need a formal acknowledgement.

faqs.question: Can I donate monthly?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can set up a standing order with your bank, or contact us on WhatsApp and we can advise on recurring giving. Recurring payments are not automated on this website.

faqs.question: Where does my donation go?
faqs.answer: Donations support our General Fund, Youth Programs, Community Events, and Outreach work. Contact us on WhatsApp if you want to direct your gift to a specific area.
